newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SHIPPING FIRM SEES 48 MLN LITAS PROFIT IN '97.
newsitem.headline: SHIPPING FIRM SEES 48 MLN LITAS PROFIT IN '97.

text.p: Lithuania's Sea Shipping Company said on Friday that it expected its 1997 profit to fall to 48 million litas from 55.8 million litas in 1996.
"The shareholders' meeting on Thursday said that the 1997 profit forecast was 48 million litas," Arvydas Stropus, the head of the company's economy department, told Reuters by telephone.
"We want to upgrade our fleet...we have acquired one new ship already this year and hope to acquire two more," he said.
He added that the company was in the process of selling off some of the older ships in its aging 40-ship fleet.
The state-run company said earlier that its 1996 net profit had fallen to 55.8 million litas from 67.7 million litas the previous year.
